# Problem 1

```{r, message=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
```

### Importing the NYC Transit dataset 
Read and clean the data; retain line, station, name, station latitude / longitude, routes served, entry, vending, entrance type, and ADA compliance. Convert the entry variable from character (YES vs NO) to a logical variable (case_match function may be useful).

```{r}
transit_df = 
  readr::read_csv(
    "data/NYC_Transit_Subway_Entrance_And_Exit_Data.csv", 
                  na = c("",".","NA")) |>
  janitor::clean_names()|> 
  dplyr::select(
    line, station_name, station_latitude, station_longitude, 
    route1:route11, entry, vending, entrance_type, ada
    ) |> 
  dplyr::mutate(
    entry = dplyr::case_match(
      entry,
      "YES" ~ TRUE,
      "NO" ~ FALSE,
      .default = NA
    )
  ) 
```
